question: The number of females per 1000 males in the population is called the ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sex ratio.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sex ratio** is defined as the **number of females per 1000 males** in a given population.
 
• In a society where the **number of males and females is equal,** there are **1000 females for every 1000 males** or a **1:1 sex ratio.**
 
• According to **National Family Health Survey, **2020-21 (NFHS-5) India's Sex ratio in 2022 is **1020 females per 1000 males.**
 
• The sex ratio is **1037 in rural areas** and** 985 females for every 1000 males** in **urban areas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **birth rate:**

 
 
• The** number of babies born** in a population in a** specific period of time **is known as the birth rate.
 
 
 
• **death rate:**
 
 
• **A population's mortality rate**, often known as the death rate, is a **measurement of the number of deaths** within that population per unit of time, scaled to that **population's size.**
 
 
 
• **literacy rate:**
 
 
• The literacy rate is calculated by dividing the population of **adults aged 7 and older **who are literate by the total population of adults in the same age group.
